interpretation.claimAttempts: SUM(jobs.attempts) counts successful claims. It is not the number of handler executions.
interpretation.handlerRuns: COUNT(job_runs) records handler entries successfully persisted by startJobRun. A worker killed after claiming but before recording its handler entry is not counted as a handler run. A recorded run killed before completion is marked interrupted after lease recovery.
interpretation.executionGuarantee: The queue provides at-least-once execution. The unique job_effects.job_id constraint and fenced completion transaction protect the tested database effect from duplicate commits.
interpretation.limitation: This harness validates the database-backed simulated effect. It does not prove exactly-once behavior for external side effects such as sending email or calling third-party APIs.
